notes: Inspiré d'un contenu du label weird_alpha qui a marché chez nous (@mentoridaily, 3c9413ba). full test BLEO : accroche jamais faite (format « things that make you X without trying »). cta A. Slide Sophia en position 4.

slides.texte_overlay:
things that make you more
likeable without trying

smiling with your eyes

a real smile reaches your eyes, not just your mouth. people feel the difference instantly, and a warm, genuine smile makes them relax around you right away.

being easily delighted

get visibly excited about small good things: a nice view, a good song, a funny story. people love being around someone who enjoys life without hiding it.

knowing a little about a lot

people warm up to someone who can join any conversation with one curious detail or question. learning a little every day makes that feel easy and natural.
slides.texte_sophia:
knowing a little about a lot

i used to stay quiet in groups. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app, a myth or a planet, and i can always add something that makes people smile.

slides.texte_overlay:
admitting what you don't know

saying i've never heard of that, tell me more makes people light up. curiosity about their world is far more likeable than pretending to know everything.

remembering the little things

remember someone's dog's name or the exam they were nervous about. small details show you truly care, and people never forget how that makes them feel.
